files.shabads/2/1125.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1125,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":7,"page_no":301,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":13745,"last_verse_id":13747,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gauree","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":13745,"page_no":301,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੪ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa chauthhaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fourth Mehla:","ms":"4th Guru."}}},{"verse_id":13746,"page_no":301,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਮਨਿ ਹਰੀ ॥","translit_en":"satigur har prabh dhas naam dhiaaiee man haree ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O True Guru, tell me of my Lord God, that I may meditate on the Naam within my mind.","ms":"My True Guru, tell me of the Lord Master, that, in my, mind, I may meditate upon His Name."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ! ਮੈਨੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀਆਂ ਗੱਲਾਂ ਸੁਣਾ (ਜਿਸ ਕਰਕੇ) ਮੈਂ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਵਿਚ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰ ਸਕਾਂ "}}},{"verse_id":13747,"page_no":301,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਪਰਹਰੀ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"naanak naam pavit har mukh bolee sabh dhukh paraharee ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, the Lord's Name is sacred and pure; chanting it, all my pain has been taken away. ||2||","ms":"By repeating with my mouth, the sacred Name of God, O Nanak, I may shake off all my agonies."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਪਵਿੱਤ੍ਰ ਹੈ (ਇਸ ਕਰਕੇ ਮਨ ਲੋਚਦਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਮੈਂ ਭੀ) ਮੂੰਹੋਂ ਉਚਾਰਨ ਕਰ ਕੇ (ਆਪਣੇ) ਸਾਰੇ ਦੁੱਖ ਦੂਰ ਕਰ ਲਵਾਂ ।੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1124,"next":1126}}

files.shabads/2/1127.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1127,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":7,"page_no":301,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":13754,"last_verse_id":13756,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gauree","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":13754,"page_no":301,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥","translit_en":"salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shalok, Fourth Mehla:","ms":"Slok 4th Guru."}}},{"verse_id":13755,"page_no":301,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੁਰਜਨਾ ॥","translit_en":"man a(n)tar haumai rog hai bhram bhoole manmukh dhurajanaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Deep within the mind is the disease of ego; the self-willed manmukhs, the evil beings, are deluded by doubt.","ms":"In the mind of the evil perverse persons is the disease of pride, and they are gone astray in doubt."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਮਨ ਵਿਚ ਹਉਮੈ ਦਾ ਰੋਗ ਹੈ, ਉਹ ਮਨ-ਦੇ-ਮੁਰੀਦ ਵਿਕਾਰੀ ਬੰਦੇ ਭਰਮ ਵਿਚ ਭੁੱਲੇ ਹੋਏ ਹਨ "}}},{"verse_id":13756,"page_no":301,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਜਨਾ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"naanak rog gavai mil satigur saadhoo sajanaa ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, this disease is eradicated, only when one meets the True Guru, our Holy Friend. ||1||","ms":"Nanak, by meeting the saintly Satguru, the friend, they get the disease eradicated."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਇਹ ਹਉਮੈ ਦਾ ਰੋਗ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨੂੰ ਮਿਲ ਕੇ ਤੇ ਸਤਸੰਗ ਵਿਚ ਰਹਿ ਕੇ ਦੂਰ ਕਰ ।੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1126,"next":1128}}

He the apostate fell into ordure and returned with still more filth attached to him."},"pu":{"ss":"ਸੰਸਾਰ ਵਿਚ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਕੋਈ ਕੋਲ ਬਹਿਣ ਨਹੀਂ ਦੇਂਦਾ, ਗੰਦ ਪੈ ਕੇ ਸਗੋਂ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਮੈਲ ਲਾ ਕੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ (ਵਾਪਸ) ਆਇਆ ।"}}},{"verse_id":13933,"page_no":306,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਪਰਾਈ ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਚੁਗਲੀ ਨੋ ਵੇਮੁਖੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਭੇਜਿਆ ਓਥੈ ਭੀ ਮੁਹੁ ਕਾਲਾ ਦੁਹਾ ਵੇਮੁਖਾ ਦਾ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥","translit_en":"paraiee jo ni(n)dhaa chugalee no vemukh kar kai bhejiaa othai bhee muh kaalaa dhuhaa vemukhaa dhaa karaiaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The faithless baymukh was sent to slander and back-bite others, but when he went there, the faces of both he and his faithless master were blackened instead.","ms":"The apostate was sent to slander and back bite others but there too the faces of both the perverse persons were got blackened."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੋ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਰਾਈ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਤੇ ਚੁਗਲੀ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ (ਸਾਲਾਹ) ਕਰ ਕੇ ਭੇਜਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਸੀ, ਉਥੇ ਭੀ ਦੋਹਾਂ ਦਾ ਮੂੰਹ ਕਾਲਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਗਿਆ "}}},{"verse_id":13934,"page_no":306,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਤੜ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਸਭਤੁ ਜਗਤ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਾਈ ਵੇਮੁਖੁ ਸਣੈ ਨਫਰੈ ਪਉਲੀ ਪਉਦੀ ਫਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਉਠਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥","translit_en":"taR suniaa sabhat jagat vich bhaiee vemukh sanai nafarai paulee paudhee faavaa hoi kai uTh ghar aaiaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"It was immediately heard throughout the whole world, O Siblings of Destiny, that this faithless man, along with his servant, was kicked and beaten with shoes; in humiliation, they got up and returned to their homes.","ms":"It was instantly heard in the whole world my brethren that the willful man along with his servant was shoe-beaten. he cries out continually, in hunger and thirst.","ms":"He has lost both this world and the world hereafter, Hungry and thirsty he ever cries out."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਸ ਦੇ ਲੋਕ ਪਰਲੋਕ ਦੋਵੇਂ ਅਜਾਈਂ ਗਏ ਤੇ (ਹੁਣ) ਭੁੱਖਾ ਤੇ ਤਿਹਾਇਆ ਕੂਕਦਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":13937,"page_no":306,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਿਆਉ ਸਚੁ ਬਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥","translit_en":"dhan dhan suaamee karataa purakh hai jin niaau sach beh aap karaiaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Blessed, blessed is the Creator, the Primal Being, our Lord and Master; files.shabads/2/1155.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1155,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":7,"page_no":306,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":5,"first_verse_id":13940,"last_verse_id":13944,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gauree","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":13940,"page_no":306,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੪ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa chauthhaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fourth Mehla:","ms":"4th Guru."}}},{"verse_id":13941,"page_no":306,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਨੰਗਾ ਭੁਖਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਨਫਰੁ ਕਿਥਹੁ ਰਜਿ ਖਾਏ ॥","translit_en":"saahib jis kaa na(n)gaa bhukhaa hovai tis dhaa nafar kithahu raj khaae ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who has a poor beggar for a master - how can he be well-fed?","ms":"He whose Master is a pauper; whence can his servant eat to repletion?"},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਨੌਕਰ ਦਾ ਮਾਲਕ ਕੰਗਾਲ ਹੋਵੇ, ਉਸ ਦੇ ਨੌਕਰ ਨੇ ਕਿੱਥੋਂ ਰੱਜ ਕੇ ਖਾਣਾ ਹੋਇਆ"}}},{"verse_id":13942,"page_no":306,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਥੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਨਫਰੈ ਹਥਿ ਆਵੈ ਅਣਹੋਦੀ ਕਿਥਹੁ ਪਾਏ ॥","translit_en":"j saahib kai ghar vath hovai su nafarai hath aavai anahodhee kithahu paae ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If there is something in his master's house, he can get it; but how can he get what is not there?","ms":"If there be something in the Master's house that his servant can get but wherefrom can he get what there is not?"},"pu":{"ss":"ਨੌਕਰ ਨੂੰ ਉਹੋ ਵਸਤ ਮਿਲ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਮਾਲਕ ਦੇ ਘਰ ਵਿਚ ਹੋਵੇ, ਜੇ ਘਰ ਵਿਚ ਹੀ ਨਾ ਹੋਵੇ ਤਾਂ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਕਿੱਥੋਂ ਮਿਲੇ?"}}},{"verse_id":13943,"page_no":306,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕੀਤੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਸਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਅਉਖੀ ਹੋਈ ॥","translit_en":"jis dhee sevaa keetee fir lekhaa ma(n)geeaai saa sevaa aaukhee hoiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Serving him, who will be called to answer for his account? files.shabads/2/1163.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1163,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":7,"page_no":308,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":9,"first_verse_id":14008,"last_verse_id":14016,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gauree","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":14008,"page_no":308,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥","translit_en":"salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shalok, Fourth Mehla:","ms":"Slok 4th Guru."}}},{"verse_id":14009,"page_no":308,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤਾਤਿ ਪਰਾਈ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਭਲਾ ॥","translit_en":"jis a(n)dhar taat paraiee hovai tis dhaa kadhe na hovee bhalaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One whose heart is filled with jealousy of others, never comes to any good.","ms":"He in whose heart there is jealousy, for others never gathers any good."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਦੇ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਵਿਚ ਪਰਾਈ ਈਰਖਾ ਹੋਵੇ, ਉਸ ਦਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਭੀ ਕਦੇ ਭਲਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦਾ, "}}},{"verse_id":14010,"page_no":308,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਓਸ ਦੈ ਆਖਿਐ ਕੋਈ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਨਿਤ ਓਜਾੜੀ ਪੂਕਾਰੇ ਖਲਾ ॥","translit_en":"os dhai aakhiaai koiee na lagai nit ojaaRee pookaare khalaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"No one pays any attention to what he says; he is just a fool, crying out endlessly in the wilderness.","ms":"None heeds what he says. By eating poison one dies forthwith."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਕੀਤੇ ਕਰਮਾਂ ਦਾ ਨਿਬੇੜਾ ਗੱਲਾਂ ਉਤੇ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦਾ, ਜੇ ਵਿਹੁ ਖਾਧੀ ਜਾਏ ਤਾਂ (ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਦੀਆਂ ਗੱਲਾਂ ਕਰਦਿਆਂ ਭੀ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਬਚ ਨਹੀਂ ਸਕਦਾ) ਤੁਰੰਤ ਮਰ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":14015,"page_no":308,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਭਾਈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਨਿਆਉ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਜੇਹਾ ਕੋਈ ਕਰੇ ਤੇਹਾ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਏ ॥","translit_en":"bhaiee vekhahu niaau sach karate kaa jehaa koiee kare tehaa koiee paae ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Siblings of Destiny, behold the justice of the True Creator; as people act, so they are rewarded.","ms":"My brethren behold the justice of the True Creator, As any one acts so is his reward."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਭਾਈ! ਸੱਚੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਾ ਨਿਆਉਂ ਵੇਖੋ, ਜਿਸ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਦਾ ਕੋਈ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਓਹੋ ਜਿਹਾ ਉਸ ਦਾ ਫਲ ਪਾ ਲੈਂਦਾ ਹੈ "}}},{"verse_id":14016,"page_no":308,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰ ਕੀਆ ਬਾਤਾ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"jan naanak kau sabh sojhee paiee har dhar keeaa baataa aakh sunaae ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Lord has bestowed total understanding upon servant Nanak; he speaks and proclaims the words of the Lord's Court. ||1||","ms":"God as imparted all understanding to serf Nanak and he explain the words of His court."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਜਿਸ ਦਾਸ ਨੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਇਹ ਸਮਝਣ ਦੀ ਸਾਰੀ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ਦਾ ਹੈ, ਉਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੇ ਦਰ ਦੀਆਂ ਇਹ ਗੱਲਾਂ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਸੁਣਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ ।੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1162,"next":1164}}

files.shabads/2/1169.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1169,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":7,"page_no":309,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":14057,"last_verse_id":14062,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gauree","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":14057,"page_no":309,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pauRee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pauree:","ms":"Pauri."}}},{"verse_id":14058,"page_no":309,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੋਤਿ ॥","translit_en":"eih sareer sabh dharam hai jis a(n)dhar sache kee vich jot ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"This body is the home of Dharma; the Divine Light of the True Lord is within it.","ms":"This body in whose heart is the light of the True One is wholly meant to practise virtue."},"pu":{"ss":"ਇਹ ਸਾਰਾ (ਮਨੁੱਖਾ) ਸਰੀਰ ਧਰਮ (ਕਮਾਉਣ ਦੀ ਥਾਂ) ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਵਿਚ ਸੱਚੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਲੁਕੀ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ "}}},{"verse_id":14059,"page_no":309,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਹਜ ਰਤਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਲੁਕਿ ਰਹੇ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਕਢੈ ਖੋਤਿ ॥","translit_en":"guhaj ratan vich luk rahe koiee gurmukh sevak kaddai khot ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Hidden within it are the jewels of mystery; how rare is that Gurmukh, that selfless servant, who digs them out.","ms":"Within it are hid the mysterious jewels. Some rare slave through the Guru mines them out."},"pu":{"ss":"ਇਸ (ਸਰੀਰ) ਵਿਚ (ਦੈਵੀ ਗੁਣ-ਰੂਪ) ਗੱੁਝੇ ਲਾਲ ਲੁਕੇ ਹੋਏ ਹਨ । ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਹੋਇਆਂ ਕੋਈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਸੇਵਕ ਇਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਪੁੱਟ ਕੇ (ਭਾਵ, ਡੂੰਘੀ ਵਿਚਾਰ ਨਾਲ) ਕੱਢਦਾ ਹੈ "}}},{"verse_id":14060,"page_no":309,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਇਕੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਇਕੋ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ॥","translit_en":"sabh aatam raam pachhaaniaa taa(n) ik raviaa iko ot pot ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When someone realizes the All-pervading Soul, then he sees the One and Only Lord permeating, through and through.","ms":"When the mortal realises the All-pervading soul then does he see the One Lord contained everywhere and the only One interwoven like warp and woof."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਜਦੋਂ ਉਹ ਸੇਵਕ ਇਹ ਲਾਲ ਲੱਭ ਲੈਂਦਾ ਹੈ) ਤਦੋਂ ਇਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਸਾਰੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਵਿਚ (ਇਸ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ) ਰਵਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਪਛਾਣਦਾ ਹੈ, ਜਿਵੇਂ ਤਾਣੇ ਤੇ ਪੇਟੇ ਵਿਚ ਇੱਕੋ ਸੂਤਰ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ "}}},{"verse_id":14061,"page_no":309,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਇਕੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਇਕੁ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਇਕੋ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਵਣ ਸਰੋਤਿ ॥","translit_en":"eik dhekhiaa ik ma(n)niaa iko suniaa sravan sarot ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He sees the One, he believes in the One, and with his ears, he listens only to the One.","ms":"He sees the One Lord he believers in the One Lord and with his ears he hears the tidings of the Lord alone."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਤਦੋਂ ਉਹ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਾਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਵਿਚ) ਇਕ ਹਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਹੀ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਹੈ, ਇਕ ਹਰੀ ਤੇ ਹੀ ਭਰੋਸਾ ਰੱਖਦਾ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਕੰਨੀਂ ਇਕ ਹਰੀ ਦੀਆਂ ਹੀ ਗੱਲਾਂ ਸੁਣਦਾ ਹੈ "}}},{"verse_id":14062,"page_no":310,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਹੋਤਿ ॥੧੬॥","translit_en":"jan naanak naam salaeh too sach sache sevaa teree hot ||16||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O servant Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord; this is your service to the Lord, the Truest of the True. ||16||","ms":"Praise thou the Lord's Name O slave Nanak This is thy service of the Truest of the True."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਦਾਸ ਨਾਨਕ! ਤੂੰ (ਭੀ ਇਸੇ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ) ਨਾਮ ਦੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰ, ਸੱਚ-ਮੁਚ ਤੇਰੀ ਇਹ ਸੇਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੇ ਦਰ ਤੇ ਕਬੂਲ ਹੋਵੇਗੀ ।੧੬।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1168,"next":1170}}
files.shabads/2/1170.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1170,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":7,"page_no":310,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":8,"first_verse_id":14063,"last_verse_id":14070,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gauree","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":14063,"page_no":310,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥","translit_en":"salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shalok, Fourth Mehla:","ms":"Slok 4th Guru."}}},{"verse_id":14064,"page_no":310,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥","translit_en":"sabh ras tin kai ridhai heh jin har vasiaa man maeh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All joy is in the hearts of those, within whose minds the Lord abides.","ms":"All the pleasures are in the mind of those within whose heart God abides."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਵਿਚ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਵੱਸ ਪਿਆ ਹੈ (ਭਾਵ, ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਮਨ ਵਿਚ ਅਨੁਭਵ ਕਰ ਲਿਆ ਹੈ), ਸਾਰੇ ਰਸ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਹਨ (ਭਾਵ, ਸੰਸਾਰਕ ਪਦਾਰਥਾਂ ਦੇ ਰਸਾਂ ਦਾ ਸੁਆਦ ਲੈਣ ਲਈ ਉਹ ਜੀਵ ਆਪਣੇ ਮਨ ਨੂੰ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਲ ਦੌੜਨ ਨਹੀਂ ਦੇਂਦੇ, ਹਿਰਦੇ ਵਿਚ ਨਾਮ-ਰਸ ਦਾ ਆਨੰਦ ਲੈਂਦੇ ਹਨ, ਜੋ ਸਭ ਰਸਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਉੱਤਮ ਰਸ ਹੈ) "}}},{"verse_id":14065,"page_no":310,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਭਿ ਦੇਖਣ ਜਾਹਿ ॥","translit_en":"har dharageh te mukh ujale tin kau sabh dhekhan jaeh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the Court of the Lord, their faces are radiant, and everyone goes to see them.","ms":"In God's court their faces are bright and all go to see them."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹਰੀ ਦੀ ਦਰਗਾਹ ਵਿਚ ਉਹ ਖਿੜੇ-ਮੱਥੇ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ; ਤੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਲੋਕ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦਾ ਦਰਸ਼ਨ ਲੋਚਦੇ ਹਨ ।"}}},{"verse_id":14066,"page_no":310,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਨ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਭਉ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥","translit_en":"jin nirabhau naam dhiaaiaa tin kau bhau koiee naeh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who meditate on the Name of the Fearless Lord have no fear.","ms":"They who meditate on the Name of the Fearless One have no fear."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿਆ ਹੈ, ਉਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ (ਆਪ ਨੂੰ ਭੀ) ਕੋਈ ਡਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਰਹਿ ਜਾਂਦਾ; "}}},{"verse_id":14067,"page_no":310,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਿ ਉਤਮੁ ਤਿਨੀ ਸਰੇਵਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਹਿ ॥","translit_en":"har utam tinee sareviaa jin kau dhur likhiaa aaeh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who have such pre-destined destiny remember the Sublime Lord.","ms":"They who are so pre-ordained, remember the Sublime Lord."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਪਰ ਇਹ) ਉੱਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਮਨੁੱਖਾਂ ਨੇ ਹੀ ਸਿਮਰਿਆ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਵਿਚ ਮੁੱਢ ਤੋਂ (ਚੰਗੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਹੋਏ ਕੰਮਾਂ ਦੇ ਸੰਸਕਾਰ) ਲਿਖੇ ਹੋਏ ਹਨ ।"}}},{"verse_id":14068,"page_no":310,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪੈਨਾਈਅਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥","translit_en":"te har dharageh painaie'eeh jin har vuThaa man maeh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those, within whose minds the Lord abides, are robed with honor in the Court of the Lord.","ms":"They in whose heart God abides are robed in God's court."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਮਨ ਵਿਚ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਵੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ (ਭਾਵ, ਪਰਗਟ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ) ਉਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਹਜ਼ੂਰੀ ਵਿਚ ਆਦਰ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਹੈ"}}},{"verse_id":14069,"page_no":310,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਓਇ ਆਪਿ ਤਰੇ ਸਭ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ ਤਿਨ ਪਿਛੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਛਡਾਹਿ ॥","translit_en":"oi aap tare sabh kuTa(n)b siau tin pichhai sabh jagat chhaddaeh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They are carried across, along with all their family, and the whole world is saved along with them.","ms":"They swim across with their entire family and in their wake the hole world is saved."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਹ ਆਪ ਸਾਰੇ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਸਮੇਤ (ਸੰਸਾਰ-ਸਾਗਰ ਤੋਂ) ਪਾਰ ਲੰਘ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ । ਤੇ, ਆਪਣੇ ਪੂਰਨਿਆਂ ਤੇ ਤੋਰ ਕੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਨੂੰ (ਵਿਕਾਰਾਂ ਤੋਂ) ਬਚਾ ਲੈਂਦੇ ਹਨ"}}},{"verse_id":14070,"page_no":310,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਜਨ ਤਿਨ ਵੇਖਿ ਵੇਖਿ ਹਮ ਜੀਵਾਹਿ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"jan naanak kau har mel jan tin vekh vekh ham jeevaeh ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Lord, please unite servant Nanak with Your humble servants; beholding them, beholding them, I live. ||1||","ms":"My God unite the servant Nanak with Thine slaves by continually beholding whom he sustains life"},"pu":{"ss":"। ਹੇ ਹਰੀ! (ਇਹੋ ਜਿਹੇ ਆਪਣੇ) ਬੰਦੇ ਦਾਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਨੂੰ ਭੀ ਮਿਲਾ । ਅਸੀ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਵੇਖ ਵੇਖ ਕੇ ਜੀਵੀਏ ।੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1169,"next":1171}}

He has brought all to bow before him."},"pu":{"ss":" ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦਾ ਬਲ ਤੇ ਆਸਰਾ ਹੈ, ਉਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੇ ਹੀ ਸਾਰੇ ਜੀਵ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਅੱਗੇ ਲਿਆ ਨਿਵਾਏ ਹਨ ।"}}},{"verse_id":14094,"page_no":310,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਨੀ ਡਿਠਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਪ ਗਵਾਈ ॥","translit_en":"jinee ddiThaa meraa satigur bhaau kar tin ke sabh paap gavaiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who have gazed lovingly upon my True Guru - all their sins are taken away.","ms":"The Lord effaces all the sins of those who have seen my True Guru with love."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ (ਹਿਰਦੇ ਵਿਚ) ਪਿਆਰ ਰੱਖ ਕੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦਾ ਦਰਸ਼ਨ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੈ, ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਪਾਪ ਦੂਰ ਕਰ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਹੈ"}}},{"verse_id":14095,"page_no":310,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਬਹੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥","translit_en":"har dharageh te mukh ujale bahu sobhaa paiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord, and they obtain great glory.","ms":"Bright become their countenances in God's court and they get great glory."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹਰੀ ਦੀ ਦਰਗਾਹ ਵਿਚ ਉਹ ਖਿੜੇ ਮੱਥੇ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ, ਤੇ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਬੜੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ"}}},{"verse_id":14096,"page_no":310,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਸਿਖ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"jan naanak ma(n)gai dhooR tin jo gur ke sikh mere bhaiee ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Servant Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of those GurSikhs, O my Siblings of Destiny. ||2||","ms":"Serf Nanak, asks for the dust of those brethren of his who are the disciples of the Guru."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਵੀਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ (ਇਹੋ ਜਿਹੇ) ਸਿੱਖ ਹਨ, ਦਾਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਚਰਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਧੂੜ ਮੰਗਦਾ ਹੈ ।੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1173,"next":1175}}

files.shabads/2/1176.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1176,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":7,"page_no":311,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":7,"first_verse_id":14103,"last_verse_id":14109,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gauree","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":14103,"page_no":311,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥","translit_en":"salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shalok, Fourth Mehla:","ms":"Salok 4th Guru."}}},{"verse_id":14104,"page_no":311,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਉਮਰਥਲ ਸੇਈ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਸੂਲੀਆ ॥","translit_en":"jinaa a(n)dhar umarathal seiee jaanan sooleeaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who have a festering boil within - they alone know its pain.","ms":"They who have carbuncle within knows its pain."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਸਰੀਰ ਵਿਚ ਗੱਦਹੁਧਾਣਾ ਫੋੜਾ ਹੈ ਉਹੋ ਹੀ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਪੀੜਾ ਨੂੰ ਜਾਣਦੇ ਹਨ "}}},{"verse_id":14105,"page_no":311,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੇਈ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਸਦ ਘੁਮਿ ਘੋਲੀਆ ॥","translit_en":"har jaaneh seiee birahu hau tin viTahu sadh ghum gholeeaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who know the pain of separation from the Lord - I am forever a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them.","ms":"I am ever a sacrifice unto those who realise the pang of separation from God."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਤਿਵੇਂ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਵਿਚ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਦਾ ਸੱਲ ਹੈ ਉਹੋ ਹੀ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਪੀੜਾ ਨੂੰ ਜਾਣਦੇ ਹਨ, ਤੇ) ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਤੋਂ ਪੈਦਾ ਹੋਏ ਪਿਆਰ ਨੂੰ ਭੀ ਉਹੀ ਸਮਝਦੇ ਹਨ—ਮੈਂ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਕੇ ਹਾਂ "}}},{"verse_id":14106,"page_no":311,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਿਰੁ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਤਲ ਰੋਲੀਆ ॥","translit_en":"har melahu sajan purakh meraa sir tin viTahu tal roleeaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Lord, please lead me to meet the Guru, the Primal Being, my Friend; my head shall roll in the dust under His feet.","ms":"O Omnipotent God unite me with the Guru the friend. My head is a sacrifice unto him and shall roll under his feet."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਹਰੀ! ਮੈਨੂੰ ਕੋਈ ਅਜੇਹਾ ਹੀ ਸੱਜਣ ਮਰਦ ਮਿਲਾ, ਅਜੇਹੇ ਬੰਦਿਆਂ (ਦੇ ਦੀਦਾਰ) ਦੀ ਖ਼ਾਤਰ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਿਰ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਪੈਰਾਂ ਹੇਠ ਰੁਲੇ ।"}}},{"verse_id":14107,"page_no":311,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਹਉ ਗੁਲਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਾ ਗੋਲੀਆ ॥","translit_en":"jo sikh gur kaar kamaaveh hau gulam tinaa kaa goleeaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I am the slave of the slaves of those GurSikhs who serve Him.","ms":"I am a slave of the slaves of those disciples of the Guru who perform his service."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੋ ਸਿੱਖ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਦੱਸੀ ਹੋਈ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ, ਮੈਂ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਗ਼ੁਲਾਮਾਂ ਦਾ ਗ਼ੁਲਾਮ ਹਾਂ, "}}},{"verse_id":14108,"page_no":311,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਭਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚੋਲੀਆ ॥","translit_en":"har ra(n)g chaloolai jo rate tin bhinee har ra(n)g choleeaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who are imbued with the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love - their robes are drenched in the Love of the Lord.","ms":"Drenched in God's love are the raiment of those who are imbued with the fast red dye of the Lord."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ-ਨਾਮ ਦੇ ਗੂੜ੍ਹੇ ਰੰਗ ਵਿਚ ਰੰਗੇ ਹੋਏ ਹਨ, ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਚੋਲੇ (ਭੀ, ਭਾਵ, ਸਰੀਰ) ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੇ ਪਿਆਰ ਵਿਚ ਭਿੱਜੇ ਹੋਏ ਹੁੰਦੇ ਹਨ "}}},{"verse_id":14109,"page_no":311,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਵੇਚਿਆ ਮੋਲੀਆ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"kar kirapaa naanak mel gur peh sir vechiaa moleeaa ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Grant Your Grace, and lead Nanak to meet the Guru; I have sold my head to Him. ||1||","ms":"My master mercifully cause Nanak to meet the Guru to whom he has sold his head for consideration."},"pu":{"ss":" ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਉਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਲ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਹੈ, ਤੇ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਿਰ ਗੁਰੂ ਅੱਗੇ ਵੇਚ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਹੈ ।੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1175,"next":1177}}

files.shabads/2/1191.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1191,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":7,"page_no":313,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":14203,"last_verse_id":14208,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gauree","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":14203,"page_no":313,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pauRee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pauree:","ms":"Pauri."}}},{"verse_id":14204,"page_no":313,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਬਣਾਈਆ ॥","translit_en":"sach sachaa kudharat jaaneeaai dhin raatee jin banaieeaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The True Lord is truly known for His all-powerful creative nature; He fashioned the days and the nights.","ms":"Truly, the True Lord who has made days and nights is known through His Omnipotence."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੇ ਦਿਨ ਤੇ ਰਾਤ (ਵਰਗੇ ਕੌਤਕ) ਬਣਾਏ ਹਨ, ਉਹ ਸੱਚਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ (ਇਸ) ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਤੋਂ ਹੀ ਸਚ-ਮੁਚ (ਵੱਡੀਆਂ ਵਡਿਆਈਆਂ ਵਾਲਾ) ਮਲੂਮ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ;"}}},{"verse_id":14205,"page_no":313,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਕੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ॥","translit_en":"so sach salaahee sadhaa sadhaa sach sache keeaa vaddiaaieeaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I praise that True Lord, forever and ever; True is the glorious greatness of the True Lord.","ms":"Ever, ever I praise that True one, True are the praises of the True one."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨ ਚਾਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ) ਮੈਂ ਸਦਾ ਉਸ ਸੱਚੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਸਿਫ਼ਤਿ-ਸਾਲਾਹ ਕਰਾਂ ਤੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਆਖਾਂ । "}}},{"verse_id":14206,"page_no":313,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ॥","translit_en":"saalaahee sach salaeh sach sach keemat kinai na paieeaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"True are the Praises of the Praiseworthy True Lord; the value of the True Lord cannot be appraised.","ms":"True is the praiseworthy Lord and true is His praise. files.shabads/2/1199.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1199,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":7,"page_no":314,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":9,"first_verse_id":14248,"last_verse_id":14256,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gauree","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":14248,"page_no":314,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੩ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa teejaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Third Mehla:","ms":"3rd Guru."}}},{"verse_id":14249,"page_no":314,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥","translit_en":"manmukh agiaan dhuramat aha(n)kaaree ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The self-willed manmukh is ignorant, evil-minded and egotistical.","ms":"The self-willed person is spiritually blind, evil-minded and arrogant."},"pu":{"ss":"ਮਨਮੁਖ ਵਿਚਾਰ-ਹੀਣ, ਖੋਟੀ ਬੁਧਿ ਵਾਲਾ ਤੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ"}}},{"verse_id":14250,"page_no":314,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਜੂਐ ਮਤਿ ਹਾਰੀ ॥","translit_en":"a(n)tar karodh jooaai mat haaree ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He is filled with anger within, and he loses his mind in the gamble.","ms":"Within him is wrath and he loses his sense as if in a gamble."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਸ ਦੇ ਮਨ ਵਿਚ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਉਹ (ਵਿਸ਼ਿਆਂ ਦੇ) ਜੂਏ ਵਿਚ ਅਕਲ ਗਵਾ ਲੈਂਦਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":14251,"page_no":314,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ ਓਹੁ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥","translit_en":"kooR kusat oh paap kamaavai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He commits the sins of fraud and unrighteousness.","ms":"He commits the sins of falsehood and unrighteousness."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਹ (ਸਦਾ) ਝੂਠ, ਫ਼ਰੇਬ ਤੇ ਪਾਪ ਦੇ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ "}}},{"verse_id":14252,"page_no":314,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਕਿਆ ਓਹੁ ਸੁਣੈ ਕਿਆ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥","translit_en":"kiaa oh sunai kiaa aakh sunaavai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"What can he hear, and what can he tell others?","ms":"What can he hear and what can he tell others?"},"pu":{"ss":"(ਇਸ ਵਾਸਤੇ) ਉਹ ਸੁਣੇ ਕੀਹ ਤੇ (ਕਿਸੇ ਨੂੰ) ਆਖ ਕੇ ਸੁਣਾਵੇ ਕੀਹ? files.shabads/2/1229.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1229,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":7,"page_no":318,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":14426,"last_verse_id":14428,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gauree","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":14426,"page_no":318,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੫ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa panjavaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fifth Mehla:","ms":"5th Guru."}}},{"verse_id":14427,"page_no":318,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥","translit_en":"naanak mitraiee tis siau sabh kichh jis kai haath ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, become friends with the One, who holds everything in His hands.","ms":"Contract friendship with Him, O Nanak, in whose hands lies every thing."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਉਸ (ਪ੍ਰਭੂ) ਨਾਲ ਦੋਸਤੀ (ਪਾਣੀ ਚਾਹੀਦੀ ਹੈ) ਜਿਸ ਦੇ ਵੱਸ ਵਿਚ ਹਰੇਕ ਗੱਲ ਹੈ,"}}},{"verse_id":14428,"page_no":318,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਕੁਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਸੇਈ ਕਾਂਢੀਅਹਿ ਇਕ ਵਿਖ ਨ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"kumitraa seiee kaa(n)dde'eeh ik vikh na chaleh saath ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They are accounted as false friends, who do not go with you, for even one step. ||2||","ms":"They are accounted false friends who go not a step with one."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਰ ਜੋ ਇਕ ਕਦਮ ਭੀ (ਅਸਾਡੇ) ਨਾਲ ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾ ਸਕਦੇ ਉਹ ਕੁਮਿੱਤਰ ਕਹੇ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ (ਉਹਨਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਮੋਹ ਨਾ ਵਧਾਂਦੇ ਫਿਰੋ) ।੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1228,"next":1230}}
files.shabads/2/1230.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1230,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":7,"page_no":318,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":14429,"last_verse_id":14434,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gauree","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":14429,"page_no":318,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pauRee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pauree:","ms":"Pauri."}}},{"verse_id":14430,"page_no":318,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਪੀਵਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥","translit_en":"a(n)mrit naam nidhaan hai mil peevahu bhaiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is Ambrosial Nectar; meet together and drink it in, O Siblings of Destiny.","ms":"The nectar is the treasure of God's Name. Meet together and quaff it, O my brethren."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਭਾਈ! ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ-(ਰੂਪ) ਖ਼ਜ਼ਾਨਾ ਹੈ, (ਇਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨੂੰ ਸਤਿਸੰਗ ਵਿਚ) ਮਿਲ ਕੇ ਪੀਵੋ । "}}},{"verse_id":14431,"page_no":318,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਭ ਤਿਖਾ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥","translit_en":"jis simarat sukh paieeaai sabh tikhaa bujhaiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Remembering Him in meditation, peace is found, and all thirst is quenched.","ms":"By remembering whom peace is obtained and all the thirst is slaked."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਸ ਨਾਮ ਨੂੰ ਸਿਮਰਿਆਂ ਸੁਖ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਹੈ, ਤੇ (ਮਾਇਆ ਦੀ) ਸਾਰੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਨਾ ਮਿਟ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":14432,"page_no":318,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਭੁਖ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥","translit_en":"kar sevaa paarabraham gur bhukh rahai na kaiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So serve the Supreme Lord God and the Guru, and you shall never be hungry again.","ms":"Serve thou the Transcendent Lord and the Guru that thou mayest hunger no more."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਹੇ ਭਾਈ!) ਗੁਰੂ ਅਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਦੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰ, (ਮਾਇਆ ਦੀ) ਕੋਈ ਭੁਖ ਨਹੀਂ ਰਹਿ ਜਾਏਗੀ । "}}},{"verse_id":14433,"page_no":318,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੁੰਨਿਆ ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈ ॥","translit_en":"sagal manorath pu(n)niaa amaraa padh paiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All your desires shall be fulfilled, and you shall obtain the status of immortality.","ms":"All thy desire shall be fulfilled and thou shalt obtain an immortal status."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿਆਂ) ਸਾਰੇ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰੇ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ, ਉਹ ਉੱਚੀ ਆਤਮਕ ਅਵਸਥਾ ਮਿਲ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਕਦੇ ਨਾਸ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦੀ ।"}}},{"verse_id":14434,"page_no":318,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੩॥","translit_en":"tudh jevadd toohai paarabraham naanak saranaiee ||3||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"You alone are as great as Yourself, O Supreme Lord God; Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||3||","ms":"As great as Thee, Thou alone art O my Supreme Lord. Nanak seeks Thine protection."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ! ਤੇਰੇ ਬਰਾਬਰ ਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ । ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਉਸ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਦੀ ਸ਼ਰਨ ਪਓ ।੩।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1229,"next":1231}}
files.shabads/2/1231.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1231,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":7,"page_no":318,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":14435,"last_verse_id":14437,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gauree","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":14435,"page_no":318,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥","translit_en":"salok mahalaa panjavaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shalok, Fifth Mehla:","ms":"Slok 5th Guru."}}},{"verse_id":14436,"page_no":318,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਡਿਠੜੋ ਹਭ ਠਾਇ ਊਣ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਜਾਇ ॥","translit_en":"ddiThaRo habh Thai uoon na kaiee jai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I have seen all places; there is no place without Him.","ms":"I have seen all the places. files.shabads/2/1232.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1232,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":7,"page_no":319,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":14438,"last_verse_id":14440,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gauree","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":14438,"page_no":319,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੫ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa panjavaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fifth Mehla:","ms":"5th Guru."}}},{"verse_id":14439,"page_no":319,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਦਾਮਨੀ ਚਮਤਕਾਰ ਤਿਉ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ਜਗ ਖੇ ॥","translit_en":"dhaamanee chamatakaar tiau varataaraa jag khe ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Like the flash of lightning, worldly affairs last only for a moment.","ms":"Brief like the flash of lightening are the worldly ostentations."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਗਤ ਦਾ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ਉਸੇ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਦਾ ਹੈ (ਜਿਵੇਂ) ਬਿਜਲੀ ਦੀ ਲਿਸ਼ਕ (ਥੋੜੇ ਚਿਰ ਲਈ ਹੀ ਹੁੰਦੀ) ਹੈ । "}}},{"verse_id":14440,"page_no":319,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਵਥੁ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸਾਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਉ ਜਪੰਦੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਣੀ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"vath suhaavee sai naanak naau japa(n)dho tis dhanee ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The only thing which is pleasing, O Nanak, is that which inspires one to meditate on the Name of the Master. ||2||","ms":"Pleasing thing is only that, O Nanak, by which one meditates on the Name of that Master."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਇਸ ਲਈ) ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਉਸ ਮਾਲਕ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਜਪਣਾ—(ਅਸਲ ਵਿਚ) ਇਹੀ ਚੀਜ਼ ਸੋਹਣੀ (ਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਟਿਕੇ ਰਹਿਣ ਵਾਲੀ) ਹੈ ।੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1231,"next":1233}}
files.shabads/2/1233.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1233,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":7,"page_no":319,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":14441,"last_verse_id":14446,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gauree","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":14441,"page_no":319,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pauRee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pauree:","ms":"Pauri."}}},{"verse_id":14442,"page_no":319,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸੋਧਿ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥","translit_en":"simirat saasatr sodh sabh kinai keem na jaanee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"People have searched all the Simritees and Shaastras, but no one knows the Lord's value.","ms":"Men have searched all the Simritis and Shastras but none has found Lord's worth."},"pu":{"ss":"ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤੀਆਂ ਸ਼ਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਾਰੇ ਚੰਗੀ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਵੇਖੇ ਹਨ, ਕਿਸੇ ਨੇ ਕਰਤਾਰ ਦੀ ਕੀਮਤ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਾਈ, (ਕੋਈ ਨਹੀਂ ਦੱਸ ਸਕਦਾ ਕਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਿਸ ਮੁੱਲ ਤੋਂ ਮਿਲ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ) ।"}}},{"verse_id":14443,"page_no":319,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀ ॥","translit_en":"jo jan bheTai saadhasa(n)g so har ra(n)g maanee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"That being, who joins the Saadh Sangat enjoys the Love of the Lord.","ms":"The person who meets the society of saints he enjoys God's love."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਸਿਰਫ਼) ਉਹ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ (ਦੇ ਮਿਲਾਪ) ਦਾ ਆਨੰਦ ਮਾਣਦਾ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਸਤਸੰਗ ਵਿਚ ਜਾ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":14444,"page_no":319,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਏਹ ਰਤਨਾ ਖਾਣੀ ॥","translit_en":"sach naam karataa purakh eh ratanaa khaanee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"True is the Naam, the Name of the Creator, the Primal Being. It is the mine of precious jewels.","ms":"True is the Name of the Omnipotent creator. It is the mine of jewels."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਾ ਸੱਚਾ ਨਾਮ, ਕਰਤਾਰ ਅਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖ—ਏਹੀ ਰਤਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਖਾਣ ਹੈ (‘ਨਾਮ’ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਵਿਚ ਹੀ ਸਾਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਹਨ)"}}},{"verse_id":14445,"page_no":319,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥","translit_en":"masatak hovai likhiaa har simar paraanee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"That mortal, who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead, meditates in remembrance on the Lord.","ms":"The mortal on whose forehead such destiny is recorded, meditates on God."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਰ ਓਹੀ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਦੇ ਮੱਥੇ ਤੇ ਭਾਗ ਹੋਣ "}}},{"verse_id":14446,"page_no":319,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਤੋਸਾ ਦਿਚੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਹਮਾਣੀ ॥੪॥","translit_en":"tosaa dhichai sach naam naanak mihamaanee ||4||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Lord, please bless Nanak, Your humble guest, with the supplies of the True Name. ||4||","ms":"O Lord, grant Nanak thy guest, the True Name as his viaticum."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ!) ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀ ਖ਼ਾਤਰਦਾਰੀ ਏਹੀ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੱਚਾ ਨਾਮ (ਰਾਹ ਲਈ) ਖ਼ਰਚ ਦੇਹ ।੪।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1232,"next":1234}}
files.shabads/2/1234.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1234,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":7,"page_no":319,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":14447,"last_verse_id":14449,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gauree","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":14447,"page_no":319,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥","translit_en":"salok mahalaa panjavaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shalok, Fifth Mehla:","ms":"Slok 5th Guru."}}},{"verse_id":14448,"page_no":319,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਨੈਣੀ ਸੁਖੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਭੁਖ ॥","translit_en":"a(n)tar chi(n)taa nainee sukhee mool na utarai bhukh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He harbors anxiety within himself, but to the eyes, he appears to be happy; his hunger never departs.","ms":"Within the man is anxiety, but to eyes he appears to be happy and his hunger never departs."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਦੇ ਮਨ ਵਿਚ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਹੈ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੀ ਭੁੱਖ ਬਿਲਕੁਲ ਨਹੀਂ ਮਿਟਦੀ; ਵੇਖਣ ਨੂੰ ਭਾਵੇਂ ਉਹ ਸੁਖੀ ਜਾਪਦਾ ਹੋਵੇ ।"}}},{"verse_id":14449,"page_no":319,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਲਥੋ ਦੁਖੁ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"naanak sache naam bin kisai na latho dhukh ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, without the True Name, no one's sorrows have ever departed. ||1||","ms":"Nanak without the True Name no man's sorrow has ever departed."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾ ਕਿਸੇ ਦਾ ਭੀ ਦੁੱਖ ਦੂਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦਾ ।੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1233,"next":1235}}
files.shabads/2/1235.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1235,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":7,"page_no":319,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":14450,"last_verse_id":14452,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gauree","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":14450,"page_no":319,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੫ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa panjavaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fifth Mehla:","ms":"5th Guru."}}},{"verse_id":14451,"page_no":319,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਮੁਠੜੇ ਸੇਈ ਸਾਥ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਲਦਿਆ ॥","translit_en":"muThaRe seiee saath jinee sach na ladhiaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those caravans which did not load the Truth have been plundered.","ms":"The caravans who load no Truth to carry with them are beguiled."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਹਨਾਂ (ਜੀਵ-) ਵਪਾਰੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਟੋਲਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਟੋਲੇ ਲੁੱਟੇ ਗਏ (ਜਾਣੋ) ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਰੂਪ ਸੌਦਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਲੱਦਿਆ, "}}},{"verse_id":14452,"page_no":319,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਇਕੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"naanak se saabaas jinee gur mil ik pachhaaniaa ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, those who meet the True Guru, and acknowledge the One Lord, are congratulated. ||2||","ms":"Nanak they who meeting the True Guru, recognise the Unique One are congratulated."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਰ ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਸ਼ਾਬਾਸ਼ੇ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨੂੰ ਮਿਲ ਕੇ ਇਕ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਨੂੰ ਪਛਾਣ ਲਿਆ ਹੈ ।੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1234,"next":1236}}
files.shabads/2/1236.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1236,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":7,"page_no":319,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":14453,"last_verse_id":14458,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gauree","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":14453,"page_no":319,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pauRee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pauree:","ms":"Pauri."}}},{"verse_id":14454,"page_no":319,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਥੈ ਬੈਸਨਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹੰਦਾ ॥","translit_en":"jithai baisan saadh jan so thaan suha(n)dhaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Beautiful is that place, where the Holy people dwell.","ms":"Beautiful is the place where the pious person sit."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਥਾਂ ਤੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਬੈਠਦੇ ਹਨ ਉਹ ਥਾਂ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ, "}}},{"verse_id":14455,"page_no":319,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਓਇ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਸਭੁ ਮੰਦਾ ॥","translit_en":"oi sevan sa(n)mrith aapanaa binasai sabh ma(n)dhaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They serve their All-powerful Lord, and they give up all their evil ways.","ms":"They serve their Omnipotent Lord and their sins are all shed."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਕਿਉਂਕਿ) ਉਹ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਬੰਦੇ (ਓਥੇ ਬੈਠ ਕੇ) ਆਪਣੇ ਸਮਰੱਥ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਸਿਮਰਦੇ ਹਨ (ਜਿਸ ਕਰਕੇ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਮਨ ਵਿਚੋਂ) ਸਾਰੀ ਬੁਰਾਈ ਨਾਸ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":14456,"page_no":319,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੰਤ ਬੇਦੁ ਕਹੰਦਾ ॥","translit_en":"patit udhaaran paarabraham sa(n)t bedh kaha(n)dhaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Saints and the Vedas proclaim, that the Supreme Lord God is the Saving Grace of sinners.","ms":"The saints and vedas say, that the Supreme Lord is the Saviour of sinners."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ! In every age Thou has been so doing."},"pu":{"ss":"ਭਗਤਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਪਿਆਰ ਕਰਨਾ—ਇਹ ਤੇਰਾ ਮੁੱਢ ਕਦੀਮਾਂ ਦਾ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਹੈ, ਤੇਰਾ ਇਹ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਸਦਾ ਕਾਇਮ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ । "}}},{"verse_id":14458,"page_no":319,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਭਾਵੰਦਾ ॥੫॥","translit_en":"naanak jaachai ek naam man tan bhaava(n)dhaa ||5||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Nanak asks for the One Name, which is pleasing to his mind and body. ||5||","ms":"Nanak asks for the One Name which is pleasing to his soul and body."},"pu":{"ss":"ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮ ਹੀ ਮੰਗਦਾ ਹੈ (ਨਾਨਕ ਨੂੰ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮ ਹੀ) ਮਨ ਤਨ ਵਿਚ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਲੱਗਦਾ ਹੈ ।੫।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1235,"next":1237}}
files.shabads/2/1237.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1237,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":7,"page_no":319,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":14459,"last_verse_id":14461,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gauree","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":14459,"page_no":319,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥","translit_en":"salok mahalaa panjavaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shalok, Fifth Mehla:","ms":"Slok 5th Guru."}}},{"verse_id":14460,"page_no":319,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਚਿੜੀ ਚੁਹਕੀ ਪਹੁ ਫੁਟੀ ਵਗਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਤਰੰਗ ॥","translit_en":"chiRee chuhakee pahu fuTee vagan bahut tara(n)g ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The sparrows are chirping, and dawn has come; the wind stirs up the waves.","ms":"with the chirping of the sparrow and breaking of dawn, many currents arise in the man."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਦੋਂ ਪਹੁ-ਫੁਟਾਲਾ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਚਿੜੀ ਚੂਕਦੀ ਹੈ, ਉਸ ਵੇਲੇ (ਭਗਤ ਦੇ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਵਿਚ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਦੇ) ਤਰੰਗ ਬਹੁਤ ਉੱਠਦੇ ਹਨ, "}}},{"verse_id":14461,"page_no":319,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਅਚਰਜ ਰੂਪ ਸੰਤਨ ਰਚੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਹਿ ਰੰਗ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"acharaj roop sa(n)tan rache naanak naameh ra(n)g ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Such a wondrous thing the Saints have fashioned, O Nanak, in the Love of the Naam. ||1||","ms":"In the love of God's Name the saints create a wondrous phenomenon."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾਂ ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਚ ਪਿਆਰ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਨੇ (ਇਸ ਪਹੁ-ਫੁਟਾਲੇ ਦੇ ਸਮੇ) ਅਚਰਜ ਰੂਪ ਰਚੇ ਹੁੰਦੇ ਹਨ (ਭਾਵ, ਉਹ ਬੰਦੇ ਇਸ ਸਮੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੇ ਅਚਰਜ ਕੌਤਕ ਆਪਣੀਆਂ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਦੇ ਸਾਹਮਣੇ ਲਿਆਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ) ।੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1236,"next":1238}}

(ਜੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਵਿੱਸਰੇ ਤਾਂ) ਦੁਨੀਆ ਦੀਆਂ ਸਾਰੀਆਂ ਵਡਿਆਈਆਂ ਸਾਰੇ ਖੋਟੇ ਮਿੱਤਰ ਹਨ ।੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1237,"next":1239}}
files.shabads/2/1239.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1239,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":7,"page_no":319,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":14465,"last_verse_id":14470,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gauree","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":14465,"page_no":319,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pauRee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pauree:","ms":"Pauri."}}},{"verse_id":14466,"page_no":319,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸਚੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਤਾ ॥","translit_en":"har dhan sachee raas hai kinai viralai jaataa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The wealth of the Lord is the true capital; how rare are those who understand this.","ms":"God's wealth is the true capital. Some rare one understands This."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਭਰਾਵੋ! ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ-ਰੂਪ ਧਨ ਸਦਾ ਕਾਇਮ ਰਹਿਣ ਵਾਲੀ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਹੈ, (ਪਰ) ਕਿਸੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਨੇ ਹੀ ਇਹ ਗੱਲ ਸਮਝੀ ਹੈ"}}},{"verse_id":14467,"page_no":319,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਤਿਸੈ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਭਾਇਰਹੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥","translit_en":"tisai paraapat bhairahu jis dhei bidhaataa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He alone receives it, O Siblings of Destiny, unto whom the Architect of Destiny gives it.","ms":"He alone receives it, O brethren, to whom the Destiny-scribe gives."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਤੇ ਇਹ ਪੂੰਜੀ) ਉਸੇ ਨੂੰ ਹੀ ਮਿਲਦੀ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਕਰਤਾਰ (ਆਪ) ਦੇਂਦਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":14468,"page_no":319,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਮਨ ਤਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਜਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥","translit_en":"man tan bheetar mauliaa har ra(n)g jan raataa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"His servant is imbued with the Love of the Lord; his body and mind blossom forth.","ms":"God's slave is imbued with the love of God who is looming forth in his mind and body."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਜਿਸ ਭਾਗਾਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਨੂੰ ਇਹ ‘ਨਾਮ’-ਰਾਸਿ ਮਿਲਦੀ ਹੈ) ਉਹ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੇ ਰੰਗ ਵਿਚ ਰੰਗਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਉਹ ਆਪਣੇ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਵਿਚ ਖਿੜ ਪੈਂਦਾ ਹੈ, "}}},{"verse_id":14469,"page_no":319,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ਸਭਿ ਦੋਖਹ ਖਾਤਾ ॥","translit_en":"saadhasa(n)g gun gaiaa sabh dhokheh khaataa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and all of his sufferings are removed.","ms":"In the society of saints he sings Lord's praises and so rids himself of all the agonies."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਜਿਉਂ ਜਿਉਂ) ਸਤਸੰਗ ਵਿਚ ਉਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ (ਤਿਉਂ ਤਿਉਂ ਉਹ) ਸਾਰੇ ਵਿਕਾਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਮੁਕਾਂਦਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":14470,"page_no":319,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਈ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਕੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੬॥","translit_en":"naanak soiee jeeviaa jin ik pachhaataa ||6||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, he alone lives, who acknowledges the One Lord. ||6||","ms":"Nanak, he alone lives, who recognises the One Lord."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਉਹੀ ਮਨੁੱਖ (ਅਸਲ ਵਿਚ) ਜੀਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੇ ਇਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹੈ ।੬।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1238,"next":1240}}
files.shabads/2/1240.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1240,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":7,"page_no":319,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":14471,"last_verse_id":14473,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gauree","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":14471,"page_no":319,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥","translit_en":"salok mahalaa panjavaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shalok, Fifth Mehla:","ms":"Slok 5th Guru."}}},{"verse_id":14472,"page_no":319,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਖਖੜੀਆ ਸੁਹਾਵੀਆ ਲਗੜੀਆ ਅਕ ਕੰਠਿ ॥","translit_en":"khakhaReeaa suhaaveeaa lagaReeaa ak ka(n)Th ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The fruit of the swallow-wort plant looks beautiful, attached to the branch of the tree;","ms":"The celandine fruits look beauteous, attached to the parent stalk."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਅੱਕ ਦੀਆਂ) ਕੱਕੜੀਆਂ (ਤਦ ਤਕ) ਮੋਹਣੀਆਂ ਹਨ (ਜਦ ਤਕ) ਅੱਕ ਦੇ ਗਲ (ਭਾਵ, ਟਹਿਣੀ ਨਾਲ) ਲੱਗੀਆਂ ਹੋਈਆਂ ਹਨ,"}}},{"verse_id":14473,"page_no":319,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਰਹ ਵਿਛੋੜਾ ਧਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਸੈ ਗੰਠਿ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"bireh vichhoRaa dhanee siau naanak sahasai ga(n)Th ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"but when it is separated from the stem of its Master, O Nanak, it breaks apart into thousands of fragments. ||1||","ms":"On severence of love with their Master, they are reduced into thousands of fragments, O Nanak."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਰ, ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਮਾਲਕ (ਅੱਕ) ਨਾਲੋਂ ਜਦੋਂ ਵਿਜੋਗ ਵਿਛੋੜਾ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਹਜ਼ਾਰਾਂ ਤੂੰਬੇ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ ।੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1239,"next":1241}}
files.shabads/2/1241.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1241,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":7,"page_no":319,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":14474,"last_verse_id":14476,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gauree","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":14474,"page_no":319,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੫ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa panjavaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fifth Mehla:","ms":"5th Guru."}}},{"verse_id":14475,"page_no":319,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਵਿਸਾਰੇਦੇ ਮਰਿ ਗਏ ਮਰਿ ਭਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਮੂਲਿ ॥","translit_en":"visaaredhe mar ge mar bh na sakeh mool ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who forget the Lord die, but they cannot die a complete death.","ms":"They who forget the Lord die, but they cannot die altogether."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਨੂੰ ਵਿਸਾਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਬੰਦੇ ਮੋਏ ਹੋਏ (ਜਾਣੋ), ਪਰ ਉਹ ਚੰਗੀ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਮਰ ਭੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਸਕਦੇ । "}}},{"verse_id":14476,"page_no":319,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਵੇਮੁਖ ਹੋਏ ਰਾਮ ਤੇ ਜਿਉ ਤਸਕਰ ਉਪਰਿ ਸੂਲਿ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"vemukh hoe raam te jiau tasakar upar sool ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who turn their backs on the Lord suffer, like the thief impaled on the gallows. ||2||","ms":"They who turn away from the Lord suffer agony, like a thief on the gallows."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਵਲੋਂ ਮੂੰਹ ਮੋੜਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੈ ਉਹ ਇਉਂ ਹਨ ਜਿਵੇਂ ਸੂਲੀ ਉਤੇ ਚਾੜ੍ਹੇ ਹੋਏ ਚੋਰ ਹਨ ।੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1240,"next":1242}}
files.shabads/2/1242.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1242,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":7,"page_no":319,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":14477,"last_verse_id":14482,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gauree","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":14477,"page_no":319,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pauRee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pauree:","ms":"Pauri."}}},{"verse_id":14478,"page_no":319,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਸੁਣਿਆ ॥","translit_en":"sukh nidhaan prabh ek hai abinaasee suniaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The One God is the treasure of peace; I have heard that He is eternal and imperishable.","ms":"I have heard the one Lord to be the treasure of imperishable peace."},"pu":{"ss":"ਇਕ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਹੀ ਸੁਖਾਂ ਦਾ ਖ਼ਜ਼ਾਨਾ ਹੈ ਜੋ (ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ) ਅਬਿਨਾਸ਼ੀ ਸੁਣੀਦਾ ਹੈ । "}}},{"verse_id":14479,"page_no":319,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਣਿਆ ॥","translit_en":"jal thal maheeal pooriaa ghaT ghaT har bhaniaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He is totally pervading the water, the land and the sky; the Lord is said to be permeating each and every heart.","ms":"God is said to be fully filling the ocean, sky and every heart."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਾਣੀ ਵਿਚ, ਧਰਤੀ ਦੇ ਅੰਦਰ, ਧਰਤੀ ਦੇ ਉਤੇ (ਉਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ) ਮੌਜੂਦ ਹੈ, ਹਰੇਕ ਸਰੀਰ ਵਿਚ ਉਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ (ਵੱਸਦਾ) ਕਿਹਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ,"}}},{"verse_id":14480,"page_no":319,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਸਭ ਇਕ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਕੀਟ ਹਸਤੀ ਬਣਿਆ ॥","translit_en":"uooch neech sabh ik samaan keeT hasatee baniaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He looks alike upon the high and the low, the ant and the elephant.","ms":"He looks equally adorned amongest all the high and low, an ant and an elephant."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉੱਚੇ ਨੀਵੇਂ ਸਾਰੇ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਵਿਚ ਇਕੋ ਜਿਹਾ ਵਰਤ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ । ਕੀੜੇ (ਤੋਂ ਲੈ ਕੇ) ਹਾਥੀ (ਤਕ, ਸਾਰੇ ਉਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤੋਂ ਹੀ) ਬਣੇ ਹਨ ।"}}},{"verse_id":14481,"page_no":319,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਮੀਤ ਸਖਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਿਪੋ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਸ ਦੇ ਜਣਿਆ ॥","translit_en":"meet sakhaa sut ba(n)dhipo sabh tis dhe janiaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Friends, companions, children and relatives are all created by Him.","ms":"The friends, comrades, sons and relatives are all created by Him."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਸਾਰੇ) ਮਿੱਤਰ, ਸਾਥੀ, ਪੁੱਤਰ ਸਨਬੰਧੀ ਸਾਰੇ ਉਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੇ ਹੀ ਪੈਦਾ ਕੀਤੇ ਹੋਏ ਹਨ । "}}},{"verse_id":14482,"page_no":319,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਤੁਸਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਣਿਆ ॥੭॥","translit_en":"tus naanak dhevai jis naam tin har ra(n)g maniaa ||7||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, one who is blessed with the Naam, enjoys the Lord's love and affection. ||7||","ms":"Whomsoever, O Nanak, God by His pleasure grants His Name, he enjoys His affection."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਜੀਵ ਨੂੰ (ਗੁਰੂ) ਨਾਨਕ ਤੁੁੱਠ ਕੇ ‘ਨਾਮ’ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਉਸ ਨੇ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ-ਨਾਮ ਦਾ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਿਆ ਹੈ ।੭।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1241,"next":1243}}

files.shabads/2/1261.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1261,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":7,"page_no":321,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":14557,"last_verse_id":14559,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gauree","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":14557,"page_no":321,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥","translit_en":"salok mahalaa panjavaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shalok, Fifth Mehla:","ms":"Slok 5th Guru."}}},{"verse_id":14558,"page_no":321,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾਚੜੀ ਸਾ ਸਾਰੁ ਜੋ ਜਾਚੰਦੀ ਹੇਕੜੋ ॥","translit_en":"jaachaRee saa saar jo jaacha(n)dhee hekaRo ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The most excellent begging is begging for the One Lord.","ms":"That is the best begging, which begs for the One Lord."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਹ ਤਰਲਾ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਚੰਗਾ ਹੈ ਜੋ (ਭਾਵ, ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਮਨੁੱਖ) ਇਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ (ਦੇ ਨਾਮ) ਨੂੰ ਮੰਗਦਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":14559,"page_no":321,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਗਾਲੑੀ ਬਿਆ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਧਣੀ ਵਿਹੂਣੀਆ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"gaal(h)ee biaa vikaar naanak dhanee vihooneeaa ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Other talk is corrupt, O Nanak, except that of the Lord Master. ||1||","ms":"Except the Name of the Master all other talks are sinful, O Nanak."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਮਾਲਕ-ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਹਰੀਆਂ ਹੋਰ ਗੱਲਾਂ ਸਭ ਵਿਅਰਥ ਹਨ ।੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1260,"next":1262}}
files.shabads/2/1262.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1262,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":7,"page_no":321,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":14560,"last_verse_id":14562,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gauree","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":14560,"page_no":321,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੫ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa panjavaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fifth Mehla:","ms":"5th Guru."}}},{"verse_id":14561,"page_no":321,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਨੀਹਿ ਜਿ ਵਿਧਾ ਮੰਨੁ ਪਛਾਣੂ ਵਿਰਲੋ ਥਿਓ ॥","translit_en":"neeh j vidhaa ma(n)n pachhaanoo viralo thio ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who recognizes the Lord is very rare; his mind is pierced through with the Love of the Lord.","ms":"There is hardly any recogniser of God, whose mind is pierces through with His Love."},"pu":{"ss":"ਅਜੇਹਾ (ਰੱਬ ਦੀ) ਪਛਾਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਕੋਈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੰਦਾ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਵਿਚ ਵਿੰਨ੍ਹਿਆ ਹੋਵੇ, "}}},{"verse_id":14562,"page_no":321,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋੜਣਹਾਰਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਧਰੁ ਪਧਰੋ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"joRanahaaraa sa(n)t naanak paadhar padharo ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Such a Saint is the Uniter, O Nanak - he straightens out the path. ||2||","ms":"Evenly smooth shall be the path, O Nanak if the saint Guru be the uniter."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਅਜੇਹਾ ਸੰਤ (ਹੋਰਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਭੀ ਰੱਬ ਨਾਲ) ਜੋੜਨ ਤੇ ਸਮਰੱਥ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ ਤੇ (ਰੱਬ ਨੂੰ ਮਿਲਣ ਲਈ) ਸਿੱਧਾ ਰਾਹ ਵਿਖਾ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਹੈ ।੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1261,"next":1263}}
files.shabads/2/1263.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1263,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":7,"page_no":321,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":14563,"last_verse_id":14568,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gauree","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":14563,"page_no":321,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pauRee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pauree:","ms":"Pauri."}}},{"verse_id":14564,"page_no":321,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਸੋਈ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ॥","translit_en":"soiee sevih jeeaRe dhaataa bakhasi(n)dh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Serve Him, O my soul, who is the Giver and the Forgiver.","ms":"My soul serve thou Him who is the Bestower and the Forgiver."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੇ! files.shabads/2/1266.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1266,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":7,"page_no":321,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":14575,"last_verse_id":14580,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gauree","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":14575,"page_no":321,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pauRee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pauree:","ms":"Pauri."}}},{"verse_id":14576,"page_no":321,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਲਾਹਾ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੇ ਖਟਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥","translit_en":"laahaa jag meh se khaTeh jin har dhan raas ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They alone earn profit in this world, who have the wealth of the Lord's Name.","ms":"They alone earn profit in the world who have the capital of the wealth of God's Name."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਗਤ ਵਿਚ ਉਹੀ (ਮਨੁੱਖ-ਵਣਜਾਰੇ) ਲਾਭ ਖੱਟਦੇ ਹਨ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਪਾਸ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ-ਰੂਪ ਧਨ ਹੈ, ਪੂੰਜੀ ਹੈ । "}}},{"verse_id":14577,"page_no":321,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਸਚੇ ਦੀ ਆਸ ॥","translit_en":"dhuteeaa bhaau na jaananee sache dhee aas ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They do not know the love of duality; files.shabads/2/1268.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1268,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":7,"page_no":321,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":9,"first_verse_id":14587,"last_verse_id":14595,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gauree","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":14587,"page_no":321,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੫ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa panjavaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fifth Mehla:","ms":"5th Guru."}}},{"verse_id":14588,"page_no":322,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਇਕੋ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jeevan padh nirabaan iko simareeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"To obtain the state of life of Nirvaanaa, meditate in remembrance on the One Lord.","ms":"To gain the immortal status remember thou the One pure Lord."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੇ ਵਾਸ਼ਨਾ-ਰਹਿਤ ਇਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਸਿਮਰੀਏ ਤਾਂ ਅਸਲੀ ਜੀਵਨ ਦਾ ਦਰਜਾ ਹਾਸਲ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ, "}}},{"verse_id":14589,"page_no":322,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਧੀਰੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"dhoojee naahee jai kin bidh dheereeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"There is no other place; how else can we be comforted?","ms":"There is no other place. Whatever the Lord does that comes to pass."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦੇ ਘਰ ਵਿਚ ਸਾਰੇ ਖ਼ਜ਼ਾਨੇ ਹਨ ਉਹ ਜੋ ਕੁਝ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ ਉਹੀ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ । "}}},{"verse_id":14622,"page_no":322,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਪਾਪਾ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ ॥","translit_en":"jap jap jeeveh sa(n)t jan paapaa mal dhovai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Saints live by chanting and meditating on the Lord, washing off the filth of their sins.","ms":"The holy-men live to contemplate and ponder over the Lord and so wash off their filth of sins."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਸ ਦੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਸਿਮਰ ਸਿਮਰ ਕੇ ਜੀਊਂਦੇ ਹਨ (ਭਾਵ, ਉਸ ਦੇ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੀ ਜ਼ਿੰਦਗੀ ਦਾ ਆਸਰਾ ਬਣਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ, ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੇ) ਪਾਪਾਂ ਦੀ ਸਾਰੀ ਮੈਲ ਧੋ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਹੈ, "}}},{"verse_id":14623,"page_no":322,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਹਿ ਸੰਕਟ ਸਭਿ ਖੋਵੈ ॥","translit_en":"charan kamal hiradhai vaseh sa(n)kaT sabh khovai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With the Lotus Feet of the Lord dwelling within the heart, all misfortune is taken away.","ms":"By abiding Lord's lotus feet in the mind, all the calamities are annulled."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੇ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਚਰਨ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਮਨ ਵਿਚ ਵੱਸਦੇ ਹਨ, ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਕਲੇਸ਼ ਨਾਸ ਕਰ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":14624,"page_no":322,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਰੋਵੈ ॥","translit_en":"gur pooraa jis bheTeeaai mar janam na rovai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who meets the Perfect Guru, shall not have to suffer through birth and death.","ms":"He who meets the Perfect Guru bewails not in birth and death."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਪਰ ਇਹ ਦਾਤਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਮਿਲਦੀ ਹੈ) ਜਿਸ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨੂੰ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਹੈ ਉਹ ਨਾਹ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੇ ਗੇੜ ਵਿਚ ਪੈਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਨਾਹ ਦੁਖੀ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":14625,"page_no":322,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵੈ ॥੧੮॥","translit_en":"prabh dharas piaas naanak ghanee kirapaa kar dhevai ||18||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Nanak is thirsty for the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan; by His Grace, He has bestowed it. ||18||","ms":"For Lord's sight Nanak has a great thirst. By His grace, He has blessed Nanak with it."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੇ ਦਰਸ਼ਨ ਦੀ ਤਾਂਘ ਨਾਨਕ ਨੂੰ ਭੀ ਬੜੀ ਤੀਬਰ ਹੈ, ਪਰ ਉਹ ਆਪਣਾ ਦਰਸ਼ਨ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਮਿਹਰ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਹੈ ।੧੮।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1274,"next":1276}}
files.shabads/2/1276.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1276,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":7,"page_no":322,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":14626,"last_verse_id":14628,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gauree","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":14626,"page_no":322,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲੋਕ ਡਖਣਾ ਮਃ ੫ ॥","translit_en":"salok ddakhanaa mahalaa panjavaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shalok, Dakhanaa, Fifth Mehla:","ms":"Slok Dakhna 5th Guru."}}},{"verse_id":14627,"page_no":322,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਭੋਰੀ ਭਰਮੁ ਵਞਾਇ ਪਿਰੀ ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਹਿਕੁ ਤੂ ॥","translit_en":"bhoree bharam van(j)ai piree muhabat hik too ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If you can dispel your doubts, even for an instant, and love your only Beloved,","ms":"If thou dispellest thy doubt a little and love the only Beloved,"},"pu":{"ss":"(ਹੇ ਭਾਈ!) ਜੇ ਤੂੰ ਰਤਾ ਭਰ ਭੀ (ਮਨ ਦੀ) ਭਟਕਣਾ ਦੂਰ ਕਰ ਦੇਵੇਂ ਤੇ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਪਿਆਰੇ (ਪ੍ਰਭੂ) ਨਾਲ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕਰੇਂ; "}}},{"verse_id":14628,"page_no":322,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਥਹੁ ਵੰਞੈ ਜਾਇ ਤਿਥਾਊ ਮਉਜੂਦੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"jithahu va(n)n(j)ai jai tithaauoo maujoodh soi ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"then wherever you go, there you shall find Him. ||1||","ms":"thou shalt find Him present there, where ever thou goest."},"pu":{"ss":"ਤਾਂ ਜਿੱਥੇ ਜਾਇਂਗਾ ਓਥੇ ਹੀ ਉਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਾਜ਼ਰ (ਦਿੱਸੇਗਾ) ।੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1275,"next":1277}}
files.shabads/2/1277.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1277,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":7,"page_no":322,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":14629,"last_verse_id":14631,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gauree","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":14629,"page_no":322,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੫ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa panjavaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fifth Mehla:","ms":"5th Guru."}}},{"verse_id":14630,"page_no":322,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਚੜਿ ਕੈ ਘੋੜੜੈ ਕੁੰਦੇ ਪਕੜਹਿ ਖੂੰਡੀ ਦੀ ਖੇਡਾਰੀ ॥","translit_en":"chaR kai ghoRaRai ku(n)dhe pakaReh khoo(n)ddee dhee kheddaaree ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Can they mount horses and handle guns, if all they know is the game of polo?","ms":"Can persons, knowing only the game of stick and ball (polo) mount horses and handle guns?"},"pu":{"ss":"(ਜੋ ਮਨੁੱਖ) ਜਾਣਦੇ ਤਾਂ ਹਨ ਖੂੰਡੀ ਦੀ ਖੇਡ ਖੇਡਣੀ, (ਪਰ) ਸੋਹਣੇ ਘੋੜੇ ਤੇ ਚੜ੍ਹ ਕੇ ਬੰਦੂਕਾਂ ਦੇ ਹੱਥੇ (ਹੱਥ ਵਿਚ) ਫੜਦੇ ਹਨ (ਉਹ ਹਾਸੋ-ਹੀਣੇ ਹੁੰਦੇ ਹਨ, ਉਹ, ਮਾਨੋ, ਇਹੋ ਜਿਹੇ ਹਨ ਕਿ)"}}},{"verse_id":14631,"page_no":322,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਹੰਸਾ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਉਲਾਸਹਿ ਕੁਕੜ ਦੀ ਓਡਾਰੀ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"ha(n)saa setee chit ulaaseh kukaR dhee oddaaree ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Can they be swans, and fulfill their conscious desires, if they can only fly like chickens? ||2||","ms":"Can the fowls which have cock like flight succeed in their hearty wish to be at par with the swans?"},"pu":{"ss":" ਕੁੱਕੜ ਦੀ ਉਡਾਰੀ ਉੱਡਣੀ ਜਾਣਦੇ ਹੋਣ ਤੇ ਹੰਸਾਂ ਨਾਲ (ਉੱਡਣ ਲਈ ਆਪਣੇ) ਮਨ ਨੂੰ ਉਤਸ਼ਾਹ ਦੇਂਦੇ ਹੋਣ । (ਤਿਵੇਂ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਮਨਮੁਖਾਂ ਦਾ ਹਾਲ ਸਮਝੋ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾਂ ਦੀ ਰੀਸ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ) ।੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1276,"next":1278}}
files.shabads/2/1278.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1278,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":7,"page_no":322,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":14632,"last_verse_id":14637,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gauree","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":14632,"page_no":322,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pauRee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pauree:","ms":"Pauri."}}},{"verse_id":14633,"page_no":322,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਰਸਨਾ ਉਚਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣੈ ਸੋ ਉਧਰੈ ਮਿਤਾ ॥","translit_en":"rasanaa ucharai har sravanee sunai so udharai mitaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who chant the Lord's Name with their tongues and hear it with their ears are saved, O my friend.","ms":"He who utters God's Name with his tongue and hears it with his ears is saves, O my friend."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਮਿੱਤਰ! ਜੋ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਜੀਭ ਨਾਲ ਹਰਿ-ਨਾਮ ਉਚਾਰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਤੇ ਕੰਨਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਹਰਿ-ਨਾਮ ਸੁਣਦਾ ਹੈ, ਉਹ (ਮਨੁੱਖ ਸੰਸਾਰ-ਸਾਗਰ ਤੋਂ) ਬਚ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ । "}}},{"verse_id":14634,"page_no":322,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲਿਖਹਿ ਲਾਇ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਸੇ ਹਸਤ ਪਵਿਤਾ ॥","translit_en":"har jas likheh lai bhaavanee se hasat pavitaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those hands which lovingly write the Praises of the Lord are pure.","ms":"The hands which write God's praise with love, are pure."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਸ ਦੇ ਉਹ ਹੱਥ ਪਵਿੱਤ੍ਰ ਹਨ ਜੋ ਸ਼ਰਧਾ ਨਾਲ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦੀ ਸਿਫ਼ਤਿ-ਸਾਲਾਹ ਲਿਖਦੇ ਹਨ । "}}},{"verse_id":14635,"page_no":322,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨਾ ਸਭਿ ਪੁੰਨ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਿਤਾ ॥","translit_en":"aThasaTh teerath majanaa sabh pu(n)n tin kitaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"It is like performing all sorts of virtuous deeds, and bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.","ms":"Such person obtains the merit of ablutions at sixty eight holies and is deemed to have performed all the virtuous deeds."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਸ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨੇ, ਮਾਨੋ, ਅਠਾਹਠ ਤੀਰਥਾਂ ਦਾ ਇਸ਼ਨਾਨ ਕਰ ਲਿਆ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਪੁੰਨ ਕਰਮ ਕਰ ਲਏ ਹਨ ।"}}},{"verse_id":14636,"page_no":322,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਤੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਗੜੁ ਜਿਤਾ ॥","translit_en":"sa(n)saar saagar te udhare bikhiaa gaR jitaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They cross over the world-ocean, and conquer the fortress of corruption.","ms":"He crosses the world -ocean and subjugates the castle of evil."},"pu":{"ss":"ਅਜੇਹੇ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਸੰਸਾਰ-ਸਮੰੁਦਰ (ਦੇ ਵਿਕਾਰਾਂ ਵਿਚ ਡੁੱਬਣ) ਤੋਂ ਬਚ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ, ਉਹਨਾਂ ਨੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਦਾ ਕਿਲ੍ਹਾ ਜਿੱਤ ਲਿਆ (ਸਮਝੋ) ।"}}},{"verse_id":14637,"page_no":323,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ਉਧਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਦਯੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਅਮਿਤਾ ॥੧੯॥","translit_en":"naanak laR lai udhaarian dhay sev amitaa ||19||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, serve the Infinite Lord; grasp the hem of His robe, and He will save you. ||19||","ms":"Nanak, serve thou the Infinite Lord, who by attaching thee to His skirt shall save thee."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਐਸੇ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਸਿਮਰ, ਜਿਸ ਨੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਲੜ ਲਾ ਕੇ (ਅਨੇਕਾਂ ਜੀਵ) ਬਚਾਏ ਹਨ ।੧੯।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1277,"next":1279}}
files.shabads/2/1279.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1279,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":7,"page_no":323,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":14638,"last_verse_id":14640,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gauree","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":14638,"page_no":323,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥","translit_en":"salok mahalaa panjavaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shalok, Fifth Mehla:","ms":"Slok 5th Guru."}}},{"verse_id":14639,"page_no":323,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਧੰਧੜੇ ਕੁਲਾਹ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹੇਕੜੋ ॥","translit_en":"dha(n)dhaRe kulaeh chit na aavai hekaRo ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Worldly affairs are unprofitable, if the One Lord does not come to mind.","ms":"Unprofitable are the worldly affairs wherein the One Lord comes not in man's min."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਹ ਕੋਝੇ ਧੰਧੇ ਘਾਟੇ ਵਾਲੇ ਹਨ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਕਾਰਨ ਇੱਕ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਚਿੱਤ ਵਿਚ ਨਾ ਆਵੇ,"}}},{"verse_id":14640,"page_no":323,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਈ ਤੰਨ ਫੁਟੰਨਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਾਂਈ ਵਿਸਰੈ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"naanak seiee ta(n)n fuTa(n)n jinaa saa(n)iee visarai ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, the bodies of those who forget their Master shall burst apart. ||1||","ms":"Nanak, burst out hose bodies who forget the Master."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਕਿਉਂਕਿ) ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਉਹ ਸਰੀਰ ਵਿਕਾਰਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਗੰਦੇ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਮਾਲਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਭੁੱਲ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ।੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1278,"next":1280}}

ਤੂੰ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਵਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈਂ) ਮੇਰੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਗੁਰੂ ਦਾ ਸ਼ਬਦ (ਗੱਜ ਰਿਹਾ) ਹੈ; ਇਹ ਹੈ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਦੀ ਮਿੱਠੀ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਸੁਰ, ਜੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਹੋ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ । ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ-ਸ਼ਬਦ ਦਾ ਨਾਦ ਵਜਾ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ ।੨।"}}},{"verse_id":16377,"page_no":360,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਪਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਮਤਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਵਰਤਮਾਨ ਬਿਭੂਤੰ ॥","translit_en":"pat veechaar giaan mat dda(n)ddaa varatamaan bibhoota(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"My cup is reflective meditation, and spiritual wisdom is my walking stick; to dwell in the Lord's Presence is the ashes I apply to my body.","ms":"Reflection is his cup, Divine knowledge his sectarian staff and to abide in Lord's presence is his ashes."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਹੇ ਜੋਗੀ! The house cat is symbolic of the mind in this body and the mouse is symbolic of material gains.","ms":"The cat of the house is now, differently instructed and it is terrified on seeing the mouse."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਜਿਸ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨੂੰ ਗੁਰੂ ਨੇ ਨਾਮ-ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪਿਲਾ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਪਹਿਲੀ) ਸੰਤੋਖ-ਹੀਣ ਬ੍ਰਿਤੀ ਬਿੱਲੀ ਹੁਣ ਹੋਰ ਕਿਸਮ ਦੀ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ ਲੈਂਦੀ ਹੈ ਉਹ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਦੇ ਪਦਾਰਥ (ਚੂਹਾ) ਵੇਖ ਕੇ ਲਾਲਚ ਕਰਨੋਂ ਸੰਗਦੀ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":17391,"page_no":381,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਅਜ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਕੇਹਰਿ ਕੂਕਰ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥","translit_en":"aj kai vas gur keeno kehar kookar tineh lagaiee re ||1|| rahaau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Guru has put the tiger under the control of the goat, and now, the dog eats grass. ||1||Pause||
Tiger is symbolic of Ego, goat is symbolic of humility. Dog represents the dark attributes (tamo gun) and grass represents the harmonious attributes (sato gun).","ms":"The Guru has given the tiger into the power of the sheep, and the dog, now, eats grass. Pause."},"pu":{"ss":"ਗੁਰੂ ਨੇ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ-ਸ਼ੇਰ ਨੂੰ ਨਿਮ੍ਰਤਾ-ਬੱਕਰੀ ਦੇ ਅਧੀਨ ਕਰ ਦਿੱਤਾ, ਉਸ ਦੇ ਤਮੋਗੁਣੀ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਿਆਂ (ਕੁੱਤਿਆਂ) ਨੂੰ ਸਤੋ ਗੁਣੀ ਪਾਸੇ (ਘਾਹ ਖਾਣ ਵਲ) ਲਾ ਦਿੱਤਾ ।੧।ਰਹਾਉ।"}}},{"verse_id":17392,"page_no":381,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਝੁ ਥੂਨੀਆ ਛਪਰਾ ਥਾਮਿੑਆ ਨੀਘਰਿਆ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰੇ ॥","translit_en":"baajh thooneeaa chhaparaa thaami(h)aa neeghariaa ghar paiaa re ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Without pillars, the roof is supported, and the homeless wandering mind has found a home.

Pillars represent material rewards, roof represents the stability of mind.","ms":"{Without pillars the thatched roof is supported and the homeless fellow has found a home."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਹੇ ਭਾਈ! ਜਿਸ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨੂੰ ਗੁਰੂ ਨੇ ਨਾਮ-ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪਿਲਾ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਮਨ ਦਾ) ਛੱਪਰ (ਛੱਤ) ਦੁਨਿਆਵੀ ਪਦਾਰਥਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਆਸਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਥੰਮ੍ਹੀਆਂ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾ ਹੀ ਥੰਮ੍ਹਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਭਟਕਦੇ ਮਨ ਨੇ (ਪ੍ਰਭੂ-ਚਰਨਾਂ ਵਿਚ) ਟਿਕਾਣਾ ਲੱਭ ਲਿਆ । "}}},{"verse_id":17393,"page_no":381,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਨੁ ਜੜੀਏ ਲੈ ਜੜਿਓ ਜੜਾਵਾ ਥੇਵਾ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਰੇ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"bin jaRe'e lai jaRio jaRaavaa thevaa acharaj laiaa re ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Without any jeweler, the jewelry has been set, and the wonderful stone of naam shines forth. ||2||","ms":"Without the setter the jewel has been set, and a wonderful precious stone is studded."},"pu":{"ss":"ਕਾਰੀਗਰ ਸੁਨਿਆਰਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਸਹਾਇਤਾ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾ ਹੀ (ਉਸ ਦੇ ਮਨ ਦਾ) ਜੜਾਊ ਗਹਿਣਾ ਤਿਆਰ ਹੋ ਗਿਆ ਤੇ ਉਸ ਮਨ-ਗਹਿਣੇ ਵਿਚ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਦਾ ਸੰੁਦਰ ਨਗ ਜੜ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਗਿਆ ।੨।"}}},{"verse_id":17394,"page_no":381,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਦਾਦੀ ਦਾਦਿ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰਾ ਚੂਪੀ ਨਿਰਨਉ ਪਾਇਆ ਰੇ ॥","translit_en":"dhaadhee dhaadh na pahuchanahaaraa choopee niranau paiaa re ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The claimant who keeps on complaining does not find justice, but by becoming calm he understands the justice in creation.","ms":"Through clamour, the beggar succeeds not, but by silence he obtains justice."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਹੇ ਭਾਈ! ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦੇ ਚਰਨਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਵਿੱਛੜ ਕੇ ਨਿੱਤ) ਗਿਲੇ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ (ਆਪਣਾ ਮਨ-ਇੱਛਤ) ਇਨਸਾਫ਼ ਕਦੇ ਭੀ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਨਹੀਂ ਸੀ ਕਰ ਸਕਦਾ (ਪਰ ਹੁਣ ਜਦੋਂ ਨਾਮ-ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮਿਲ ਗਿਆ ਤਾਂ) ਸ਼ਾਂਤ-ਚਿੱਤ ਹੋਏ ਨੂੰ ਇਨਸਾਫ਼ ਮਿਲਣ ਲੱਗ ਪਿਆ (ਇਹ ਯਕੀਨ ਬਣ ਗਿਆ ਕਿ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਜੋ ਕੁਝ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ ਠੀਕ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ) ।"}}},{"verse_id":17395,"page_no":381,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਲਿ ਦੁਲੀਚੈ ਬੈਠੀ ਲੇ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਨੈਨ ਦਿਖਾਲਨੁ ਧਾਇਆ ਰੇ ॥੩॥","translit_en":"maal dhuleechai baiThee le mritak nain dhikhaalan dhaiaa re ||3||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The ego that used to sit on costly carpets has died and the tendency to glare at others has gone away. ||3||
costly carpets is symbolism for place of consequence.","ms":"The dead sit on the costly carpets and what is seen with the eyes shall quickly vanish."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਨਾਮ-ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਦੀ ਬਰਕਤਿ ਨਾਲ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਦਾ ਪਹਿਲਾ) ਹੋਰਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਘੂਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਮੁੱਕ ਗਿਆ, ਦੁਲੀਚੇ ਮੱਲ ਕੇ ਬੈਠਣ ਵਾਲੀ (ਅਹੰਕਾਰ-ਭਰੀ ਬਿਰਤੀ) ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਹੁਣ ਆਤਮਕ ਮੌਤੇ ਮਰੀ ਹੋਈ ਦਿੱਸਣ ਲੱਗ ਪਈ ।੩।"}}},{"verse_id":17396,"page_no":382,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਸੋਈ ਅਜਾਣੁ ਕਹੈ ਮੈ ਜਾਨਾ ਜਾਨਣਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਛਾਨਾ ਰੇ ॥","translit_en":"soiee ajaan kahai mai jaanaa jaananahaar na chhaanaa re ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who claims to know, is ignorant; The one who understands, cannot remain hidden.","ms":"Ignorant is he, who says he knows. The Knower remains not obscure."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਭਾਈ! ਜੇਹੜਾ ਮਨੁੱਖ (ਨਿਰਾ ਜ਼ਬਾਨੀ ਜ਼ਬਾਨੀ) ਆਖਦਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਮੈਂ (ਆਤਮਕ ਜੀਵਨ ਦੇ ਭੇਤ ਨੂੰ) ਸਮਝ ਲਿਆ ਹੈ ਉਹ ਅਜੇ ਮੂਰਖ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਨੇ (ਸਚਮੁਚ ਆਤਮਕ ਜੀਵਨ ਨੂੰ ਨਾਮ-ਰਸ ਨੂੰ) ਸਮਝ ਲਿਆ ਹੈ ਉਹ ਕਦੇ ਗੁੱਝਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":17397,"page_no":382,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਮਿਉ ਪੀਆਇਆ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਬਿਗਸਾਨਾ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੫॥੪੪॥","translit_en":"kahu naanak gur amiau peeaaiaa rasak rasak bigasaanaa re ||4||5||44||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Says Nanak, the Guru has given me the Ambrosial Nectar to drink in; savoring it and relishing it, I blossom forth in bliss. ||4||5||44||","ms":"Says Nanak, the Guru has given me nectar to drink and saturated with the love of Lord I am now elated."},"pu":{"ss":" ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਆਖ—ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਗੁਰੂ ਨੇ ਆਤਮਕ ਜੀਵਨ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਨਾਮ-ਜਲ ਪਿਲਾ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਹੈ ਉਹ ਇਸ ਨਾਮ-ਜਲ ਦਾ ਸੁਆਦ ਮਾਣ ਮਾਣ ਕੇ ਸਦਾ ਖਿੜਿਆ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ ।੪।੫।੪੪।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1478,"next":1480}}
